prompt: What should a worker do if they need an extra-large jacket?
promptZh: 工作人員如果需要 XL 尺寸的外套，應怎麼做？
evidence: The fitting desk has a separate supply, but there are no jackets in size XL today. / If you need that size, leave your name. / We’ll check the next delivery on Saturday morning.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The fitting desk has a separate supply, but there are no jackets in size XL today.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you need that size, leave your name.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We’ll check the next delivery on Saturday morning.

options.text: Take a red-tagged jacket for the day.
options.zh: 先拿一件紅標外套用一天。
options.whyZh: 紅標外套已留給晚班，不能當成備用尺寸拿取。

options.text: Wait at the staff entrance until a new jacket arrives Friday.
options.zh: 週五在員工入口等新的外套送到。
options.whyZh: 工作人員會在週六早上查看下一批到貨，不是要人在週五留在入口等。

options.text: Give their name so staff can check the next delivery.
options.zh: 留下姓名，讓工作人員查下一批到貨。
options.whyZh: 今天沒有加大尺寸備品，錄音請需要的人留下姓名，週六查貨。

options.text: Go directly to the delivery entrance and collect one.
options.zh: 直接到送貨入口領一件。
options.whyZh: 通知沒有要求自行去送貨入口，也沒有保證現在有加大尺寸。

explanationZh: 今天沒有加大尺寸備品，錄音請需要的人留下姓名，週六查貨。

vocabulary.note: 指工作人員週六早上會查看的下一批貨。
